plan.describe:
LinkedIn calls this CMS can make, and nothing else:

  POST   www.linkedin.com/oauth/v2/accessToken
    to        exchange an authorization code, or a refresh token, for an access token
    scopes    (app credentials)
    returns   this app's own access token for the member who consented

  POST   www.linkedin.com/oauth/v2/introspectToken
    to        check whether a token is active, when it expires and what it may do
    scopes    (app credentials)
    returns   the status, expiry and scopes of this app's own token

  GET    api.linkedin.com/v2/userinfo
    to        learn which member authorized the app, to name their own person URN
    scopes    openid | profile
    returns   the authenticated member's own id and name

  GET    api.linkedin.com/rest/organizationAcls
    to        list the pages the member may post to
    scopes    r_organization_admin | rw_organization_admin
    returns   the authenticated member's own page roles

  GET    api.linkedin.com/rest/organizations/{id}
    to        show a page's name next to its URN
    scopes    r_organization_admin | rw_organization_admin
    returns   the own public name of a page the member administers

  POST   api.linkedin.com/rest/posts   [write]
    to        publish an approved draft as its author
    scopes    w_organization_social | w_member_social
    returns   the id of the author's own new post

  GET    api.linkedin.com/rest/posts/{urn}
    to        confirm a post published
    scopes    r_organization_social | rw_organization_admin | r_member_social
    returns   the author's own post, as published

  GET    api.linkedin.com/rest/posts
    to        list what the configured author already published
    scopes    r_organization_social | rw_organization_admin | r_member_social
    returns   the configured author's own recent posts

  DELETE api.linkedin.com/rest/posts/{urn}   [write]
    to        withdraw a post the author published
    scopes    w_organization_social | w_member_social
    returns   nothing; it removes the author's own post

  POST   api.linkedin.com/rest/images   [write]
    to        reserve an upload for a link card's thumbnail
    scopes    w_organization_social | w_member_social
    returns   an upload slot for the author's own image

  PUT    <upload slot on linkedin.com>   [write]
    to        send the thumbnail's bytes to the slot LinkedIn returned
    scopes    w_organization_social | w_member_social
    returns   nothing; it stores the author's own image

  GET    api.linkedin.com/rest/images/{urn}
    to        wait for an uploaded thumbnail to finish processing
    scopes    w_organization_social
    returns   the processing status of the author's own image

  GET    api.linkedin.com/rest/organizationalEntityShareStatistics
    to        read how the page's published posts performed
    scopes    r_organization_admin | rw_organization_admin
    returns   aggregate counts for the page's own posts

  GET    api.linkedin.com/rest/memberCreatorPostAnalytics
    to        read how a member's published post performed
    scopes    r_member_postAnalytics
    returns   aggregate counts for the member's own post

No member profiles, connections, followers, feeds or messages. No record of who
engaged with a post — aggregate counts only, for the author's own posts.
